newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary c,bank to issue new 1-yr bonds of HUF75bln.
newsitem.headline: Hungary c,bank to issue new 1-yr bonds of HUF75bln.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) will issue the second series of its new one-year bonds, worth 75 billion forints, on July 9, the NBH said on Friday in a statement in the Budapest Stock Exchange's official gazette.
The bonds of the 1998/2 series will be sold to domestic investors between July 9 and August 8, but the NBH may close or suspend the sales earlier.
The NBH will update the price of the bonds daily, it said, adding that the price may change even within one day.
The yield on the NBH's 1998/1 series bonds, issued two weeks ago, remained unchanged on Friday at 20.27 percent.
